figs.name: gray-code-absolute-encoder-disc-diagram
figs.alt: Gray code absolute encoder disc with four tracks and 16 positions
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog drawing a 4 bit Gray code encoder disc: four concentric tracks give 16 positions, and every neighbouring sector differs in only one track.

figs.name: gray-code-to-binary-decoding-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart of Gray code to binary decoding with XOR, 1011 to 1101
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the decoding loop from the article: copy the MSB, XOR each result with the next Gray bit, so Gray 1011 becomes binary 1101, decimal 13.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart of Gray to binary decoding with XOR</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e1b4b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gray to Binary Decoding Loop</text>
<rect x="240" y="56" width="320" height="56" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="90.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Start with Gray 1011</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="132" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="240" y="132" width="320" height="64" rx="10" fill="#4338ca" stroke="#1e1b4b" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="158.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Copy MSB</text>
<text x="400.0" y="182.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">B3 = G3 = 1</text>
<line x1="400" y1="196" x2="400" y2="216" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="240" y="216" width="320" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="242.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Next bit: B = previous B</text>
<text x="400.0" y="265.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">XOR next Gray bit</text>
<line x1="400" y1="280" x2="400" y2="300" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,300.0 550.0,350 400,400.0 250.0,350" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e1b4b" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="356.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LSB done?</text>
<polyline points="250,350 180,350 180,248 238,248" fill="none" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="170" y="340" font-size="17" fill="#4338ca" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">No</text>
<line x1="400" y1="400" x2="400" y2="430" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="422" font-size="17" fill="#1e1b4b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="240" y="430" width="320" height="64" rx="10" fill="#1e1b4b" stroke="#1e1b4b" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="456.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Binary 1101</text>
<text x="400.0" y="481.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">decimal 13</text>
<rect x="590" y="132" width="190" height="230" rx="12" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="685" y="176" font-size="17" fill="#1e1b4b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">B3 = 1</text>
<text x="685" y="226" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">B2 = 1 XOR 0 = 1</text>
<text x="685" y="276" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">B1 = 1 XOR 1 = 0</text>
<text x="685" y="326" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">B0 = 0 XOR 1 = 1</text>
<text x="400" y="540" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Each step needs the binary bit just found, so decoding runs MSB first</text>
<text x="400" y="568" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Encoding needs no chain: G = B XOR (B shifted right by 1)</text>
</svg>

figs.name: gray-code-vs-binary-transition-infographic
figs.alt: Gray code vs binary transition from 7 to 8, one bit change instead of four
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing the 7 to 8 step: binary 0111 to 1000 flips four bits, Gray 0100 to 1100 flips one, plus the XOR conversion of 13 to 1011.
figs.after_h2: Why Does Binary Counting Cause Errors?
